It was a Tuesday night.
We met so randomly, as if the universe had forgotten it wasn't supposed to happen. At exactly midnight, she left everything behind just to come and see him.
We sat by the lakeshore with Tujhko playing at full volume. The world had gone silent. It was just the song, the water, and him beside me, looking into my eyes and singing every word as if it had only ever been written for me.
The cruelest part?
We both knew we were never meant to belong to each other.
Yet there we were... loving each other with a love that had nowhere to go. Carrying the quiet ache of a goodbye that hadn't happened yet. Meeting each other as if it were the first time, while our hearts already knew it would never last.
Months have passed, but every time this song plays, I don't hear Arijit Singh anymore. I hear him.
For a few minutes, I'm back at that lake. Midnight. His eyes. His voice. And the version of us that existed only for one beautiful, impossible night.
Some people leave your life.
Some never leave your soul.
A part of me will always search for him in songs, in lakes, in quiet nights, and in every version of love that never got the chance to stay🤍

Months have passed, but every time this song plays, I don't hear Arijit Singh anymore. I hear him.
For a few minutes, I'm back at that lake. Midnight. His eyes. His voice. And the version of us that existed only for one beautiful, impossible night.
Some people leave your life.
Some never leave your soul.
A part of me will always search for him in songs, in lakes, in quiet nights, and in every version of love that never got the chance to stay🤍
